description: This file defines the LoanChargeDataV1Enricher class, which implements the DataEnricher interface to enrich LoanChargeDataV1 objects with external owner IDs based on loan ID lookup.

classes.name: LoanChargeDataV1Enricher
classes.description: A Spring component that enriches LoanChargeDataV1 objects with external owner IDs by fetching owner data via repository and mapping external identifiers.

methods.name: isDataTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the provided data type is supported by this enricher (i.e., if it is a LoanChargeDataV1).

methods.name: enrich
methods.description: Enrichs the LoanChargeDataV1 object with external owner ID if an active owner is found for the associated loan ID.
